prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Make a NEW eight-row animation sheet of the SAME wooden ASH FERRYMAN creature shown in the reference. Reference only supplies identity: dark teal little boat hull with cream rail, triangular hood/sail, four rootlike oar legs. All side-view facing right. Tiny 32x32-pixel native sprite style with flat square pixels and about 15 muted teal/bark/cream colors, no smooth shading.
Layout is STRICT: 4 COLUMNS × 8 ROWS. Exactly THIRTY-TWO sprites. Eight horizontal bands of equal height. Transparent tall 1:2 canvas. Every sprite same scale, fits its cell fully with margins, same feet baseline. No labels, no text, no grid lines, no background, no antialiasing.
Draw each cell as follows:
ROW ONE, cells1-4 IDLE: hood straight, hood curls left, hood curls right, hood relaxes. Lantern swings in four different angles; hull level.
ROW TWO, cells5-8 WALK: front oars forward, front oars planted, back oars forward, back oars planted. Four clearly different leg shapes.
ROW THREE, cells9-12 WINDUP: crouch, bow lifts, stern lowers, hood opens. Small AMBER lantern only this row.
ROW FOUR, cells13-16 ATTACK: oars sweep out, prow thrusts, hull rocks backward, prow slams.
ROW FIVE, cells17-20 RECOVERY: bow raised after impact, stern bounces, sail flexes backward, sail flexes forward. Four NEW different recovering poses. This row has NO glowing core.
ROW SIX, cells21-24 VULNERABLE: hood unrolls, ribs spread, core pulses, hull shudders. Small CYAN core in all four sprites of this row only.
ROW SEVEN, cells25-28 HURT: mast bends sideways, front rail buckles, rear rail buckles, oars brace.
ROW EIGHT, cells29-32 DEATH: mast cracks, hull tips onto side, ribs collapse, settled broken boat heap.
Eight rows are mandatory, including both separate RECOVERY and VULNERABLE rows. All32are actually new articulated drawings, not copied shifted sprites. Empty transparent margins between sprites. Retain the reference's strange garden creature identity.
